description: ORCINUS: a verification-first engineering skill collection — one integrated nervous system for the 0–100 software lifecycle, from raw idea to release. Router + 35 focused sub-skills, shared glossary, evidence bundles, independent review. No auto-merge, no weakened tests. Evidence bundles are tamper-evident, not proof of execution: a test gate must invoke a recognised test runner and its JUnit report must agree with the recorded command and stdout, but a command that runs a runner and then fabricates consistent artifacts can still validate. A local PASS bundle is provisional; VERIFIED means the revision was attested in CI; a local targeted rerun mints only RERUN_CONFIRMED, never VERIFIED.
name: orcinus-skills
